_note: Patrols (scripts/core/patrol.gd, autoload Patrols). The deputy (an NPC id) hands them out: kind = hunting or border (weights), mates = 0..max_mates of the cats in `cats` whose rank is in `ranks` (solo_chance: none at all). Mates need a walk animation (data/cats.json). A hunting patrol is done when prey_goal (solo / group) prey are delivered to the fresh-catch pile; a border patrol when every scent spot it names is marked and the deputy is told. Border spots: every scent_spots entry of border.area, plus with extra_chance 1..extra_max of border.extra_area's. The patrol meets at the marker `meet` in camp (mates wait meet_gap px apart) and leaves through `entrance_exit`; mates then follow Fern follow_gap px apart along her trail (follow_speed px/s at most) into every outdoor area, and walk home (home_speed) when it is over.
